issue.title: CRF Talker Advertise declares the AAF MaxFrameSize (217, not 29): KL_pp_shadow drives every TSpec slot with talker 0's value
issue.body:
**The CRF Talker Advertise declares the AAF talker's MaxFrameSize.**

**On the wire**, on the e2 development image of dev a032c6d6:
- The CRF stream (…0001) is declared with MaxFrameSize **217**, MaxIntervalFrames 1, VLAN 2 and PCP 3.
- 217 is the AAF 8-channel value. Milan v1.2 4.3.3.2 Table 4.4 gives CRF, 1 timestamp per PDU, MaxFrameSize 28 + 1 = 29 (IEEE 802.1Q-2018 35.2.2.8.4 a)).

**Cause (integration half of protocol-processor #190):**
- The processor takes the TSpec MaxFrameSize per source since its PR #194 (`cfg_tspec_max_frame_i[N_STREAM_OUT_P*16-1:0]`), and it is adopted at 93fb0b2d.
- `hdl/milan/KL_pp_shadow.sv:1283` still drives every slot with one 16-bit value (`{N_STREAM_OUT_P{cfg_tspec_max_frame_i}}`, port at :301).
- `hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv:9381-9385` feeds that value from talker 0, the AAF formula (24*N + 24 + 1).

**Required:**
- Widen the wrapper port to one value per stream output.
- Drive each source's value from its own format: AAF 24*N + 24 + 1, and CRF 28 + 1 for one timestamp per PDU. Derive it from the format and shape, not as a literal.
- Prove it on the wire model with a test that fails on the current per-slot copy, for both the 1x1 and 8x8 shapes.

Relates to protocol-processor #190.

[A665] TAKEN
Branch: 774-crf-tspec-max-frame (from dev a032c6d6)
Authoritative references: Milan v1.2 4.3.3.2 Table 4.4 (AAF PCM32 48 kHz 24*N + 24 + 1; CRF 1 ts/pdu 28 + 1); IEEE 802.1Q-2018 35.2.2.8.4 a); protocol-processor PR #194 per-source `cfg_tspec_max_frame_i[N_STREAM_OUT_P*16-1:0]` (pin 93fb0b2d); assignment https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/774#issuecomment-6379902807
Interpreted scope: widen `KL_pp_shadow.cfg_tspec_max_frame_i` to one 16-bit MaxFrameSize per stream output and pass it straight to the processor; in `milan_datapath.sv` drive AAF slot t from that talker's own TSpec geometry (24 x channels + 24 + 1, the existing tctx_maxf_w derivation) and the CRF Media Clock Output slot from the CRF framer's PDU shape (20-octet CRF header + 8 x timestamps per PDU + 1 = 29), no literal; drop the "scratch only" comment. Prove the declared MaxFrameSize of every source on the DUT's own MSRP Talker Advertise in milan_dp at the AX 1x1 TDM8 and AX 8x8 shapes, with a planted control that copies talker 0's value to every slot and must fail.
Validation plan: the touched milan_dp legs and their planted control; the full sweep as 4 shard units; Yosys; lint; the docs gates under make 4.3; route-1x1, ooc-1x1 and ooc-8x8 checked against the eleventh record, one Vivado run at a time.
Blockers: none

[A665] REVIEW READY
Commit: 5f0d5bf931c87f3e6e3b813e042c64a61f9cb13e (branch 774-crf-tspec-max-frame on dev a032c6d6, not pushed; three commits: e70a99ba the change, 124adf7e the regenerated module matrix, 5f0d5bf9 three edited table rows without em dashes; the last two change Markdown only)
Changed:
- `KL_pp_shadow.cfg_tspec_max_frame_i` is `[N_STREAM_OUT_P*16-1:0]`, one MaxFrameSize per stream output, passed straight to the processor's per-source port (PR #194, pin 93fb0b2d); the "scratch only" every-slot copy is gone.
- `milan_datapath.sv` `g_pp_maxf`: AAF talker t declares its own `tctx_maxf_w[t]` (24 x channels + 24 + 1); the CRF Media Clock Output slot declares `KL_crf_tx.tspec_max_frame_o`, the AVTPDU it builds (20-octet header + crf_data_length 8) + 1 = 29. No literal: `KL_crf_tx`'s AVTPDU length is now derived from its header and crf_data_length.
- milan_dp `[TSPEC]`: the TSpec of every Talker Advertise value the DUT sends (a packed vector's values carry FirstValue's TSpec, IEEE 802.1Q-2018 35.2.2.8) graded per source against Milan v1.2 4.3.3.2 Table 4.4 computed in the harness, MaxIntervalFrames 1, and on the 1x1 against the emitted AVTPDU + 1. On `obj_crflic` (AX 1x1 TDM8) and a new `obj_tspec8` leg (AX 8x8, nine sources) in the default run. Planted control in `make crflic-mutants`: every source given talker 0's value (dev's behaviour).
- Docs: milan_dp README, TESTING.md, 802.1Q SRP-10, compliance matrix 4.3.3, the LWSRP_TSPEC note, the submodule adoption row, CHANGELOG, the generated module matrix.
Validation:
- `obj_crflic` 427 checks, 0 failures (uid 0 AAF 217, uid 1 CRF 29, both = emitted AVTPDU + 1); `obj_tspec8` 61/0 (uids 0..7 217, uid 8 29).
- `make -C tb/verilator/milan_dp crflic-mutants`: 10 checks: 10 PASS, 0 FAIL. The talker-0 control fails "CRF TSpec MaxFrameSize is Milan v1.2 Table 4.4's 28 + 1" got=217 exp=29 on both shapes (3 of 427 and 2 of 61 checks fail).
- Full sweep at 5f0d5bf9, 4 shard units: 64/64 suites, 2,189,325 checks, 0 failures; tsn_fuzz re-run with tsn-gen at deca300c: all campaigns pass, 899 checks.
- Yosys 60/60 tops PASS (tied-input, tap-purity PASS); lint PASS 89 <= 89; docs gates under GNU Make 4.3 / CPython 3.12.3: 44 steps, 0 failed (2 skipped by rule), builder leg 1 with LiteX rc 0, Markdown gates 5/5, no-git pair rc 0.
- Against the eleventh record, recipe unchanged, one Vivado run at a time: route-1x1 PASS, LUT 51,496 (+237), FF 53,268 (+60), SLICE 15,831 (-4; 19 free), BRAM/DSP unchanged, WNS +0.281 ns, WHS +0.009 ns, route complete; ooc-1x1 PASS (LUT +19); ooc-8x8 PASS (LUT +45, FF +1). The +5-slice STOP is not met and no tolerance is exceeded.
Acceptance criteria: met: the port is per source (1); each source's value comes from its own format and shape, AAF 24*N + 24 + 1 and CRF 28 + 1, with the scratch comment removed (2); declared per source on the wire model for 1x1 and 8x8, with the talker-0 control failing on both (3); every gate in item 4 rc 0 (4).
Open risks/questions: `scripts/ci_tool_inventory.py --check` already refuses at dev a032c6d6 on an unrelated changed script (`sw/builder/endstation_builder.py`), so `ci/image/tool-inventory.json` and `command-table.json` were not regenerated here; when they are, they need this change's `crflic_mutants.py` digest and the new `Vmilan_dp_tspec8` command.

[A665] REVIEW READY
